authorship: Root-authored synthetic competence checks, not natural data or held-out evaluation

requests.prompt:
Source [control_old p.1]: An administrative report states that District A handled 40 applications in fiscal year 2021. Its reserve fund was 7 units.
Source [control_new p.1]: A correction replaces the fiscal-year-2021 application count of 40 with 34 for the same district and year. The reserve fund remains 7 units.
Question: What is the corrected application count, and did the fiscal year covered by that count change? Cite the supplied source page.

Source [sample_old p.1]: An analysis used 80 participants. The instrument calibration distance was 12 metres.
Source [sample_new p.1]: A revised analysis uses 72 participants after excluding eight with missing baseline measurements. The instrument calibration distance remains 12 metres.
Question: Is the set of participants unchanged between versions, and what calibration distance is retained? Cite the supplied source page.

required_facts: The count still covers fiscal year 2021; no period change.
references.required_scope: Do not change the district or reporting period. Repeating District A is not required when context is unambiguous.
failures: Claims no evidence when an explicit correction was supplied

references.required_scope: Distinguish changed participant set from independently unchanged calibration.

gate: Both controls must satisfy all required facts and scope without contradictory assertions; at least one sufficient citation each. Free prose/synonyms accepted. Format assessed independently; no exact-label or JSON requirement. Root source-conditioned scoring before main predictions; disclose model assistance.
format_instruction: Concise prose and [document_id p.N] citations; no JSON or task enums.
main_comparison_allowed_if_pass: Pilot reader competence only; not a strong-reader certificate.
